brief:
More than 100 writers and literary figures are forming a splinter chapter from PEN America, the free-expression organization, over tensions regarding the Gaza conflict, The Guardian reported. The new group, called PEN Writes US, reflects divisions within the organization's membership on how it has addressed the war.

The breakaway chapter signals discord among prominent authors and literary professionals within one of the world's leading defenders of free speech and human rights. PEN America's approach to Gaza-related speech and advocacy has become a point of contention among its diverse membership.

title: Over 100 writers split from PEN America over Gaza stance
